newsitem.title: USA: Unisource Worldwide down on weaker outlook. [CORRECTED 21:57 GMT]
newsitem.headline: Unisource Worldwide down on weaker outlook. [CORRECTED 21:57 GMT]

text.p: Shares of Unisource Worldwide fell sharply on Thursday after the company announced it would post disappointing earnings and revenues in the second quarter.
The Valley Forge, Pa.-based company on Wednesday said earnings could be as much as $0.15 to $0.20 below analysts' consensus estimates of $0.36.
The company cited reduced prices for printing paper for the expected disappointment. Unisource's business plan had assumed relatively flat paper prices.
"We don't believe it's a reflection of lost market share as much as that our projections were higher than were realized (corrects quote)," said JoAnn Huston, investor relations manager.
Unisource shares were trading at 16, down 3-3/4.
